title: TOTP second factor and a Twilio Verify adapter

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.precondition: Signed-in user with a PIN and a known password
cases.steps: 1. Start TOTP enrolment with the password
cases.expected: A pending secret exists, the response carries the secret and an otpauth URI once, TOTP is not active
cases.actual: A pending secret exists with an otpauth URI that carries it; TOTP stays inactive until confirmed.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Start enrolment with a wrong password
cases.expected: 401 ERR_INVALID_CREDENTIALS and no secret is created
cases.actual: ErrInvalidCredentials; no user_totp row is created.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Confirm with the current code
cases.expected: TOTP active, 10 recovery codes returned once and stored only as hashes
cases.actual: TOTP active, 10 recovery codes returned, 10 SHA-256 hashes stored and none equals a code.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Confirm with wrong codes five times, then the right one
cases.expected: Stays inactive; the fifth wrong attempt locks TOTP use; the right code is refused while locked
cases.actual: Four wrong codes ErrTOTPInvalid, the fifth ErrTOTPLocked, the right code refused while locked.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Verify codes for the previous, current and next time step\n2. Verify a code two steps away
cases.expected: One step of drift is accepted, two steps are refused
cases.actual: Offsets -1, 0 and +1 accepted; -2 and +2 refused.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Verify a code\n2. Verify the same code again
cases.expected: The second use is refused: a step is accepted once
cases.actual: The step used at activation is refused, a fresh step accepted once, a replay refused.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.precondition: An active TOTP and recovery codes
cases.steps: 1. Verify with a recovery code\n2. Verify with the same recovery code
cases.expected: Accepted once, then burnt; the remaining count drops by one
cases.actual: A recovery code accepted once, refused the second time, count goes 10 to 9.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Read the stored secret from the database\n2. Compare with the secret shown at enrolment
cases.expected: The stored value is ciphertext, not the secret; a wrong key cannot decrypt it
cases.actual: Stored value is ciphertext, a wrong key cannot decrypt it, the right key can; tampering is detected (GCM).

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Eight parallel verifications with the same valid code
cases.expected: Exactly one succeeds
cases.actual: Exactly one of 8 parallel verifications wins; exactly one of 16 parallel claims of a step wins (store level).

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.precondition: User with active TOTP and a PIN; an offer with the 2fa band
cases.steps: 1. Request a transaction at or above 50,000,000 VND
cases.expected: The request is held in awaiting_auth with auth_method 2fa (no longer refused)
cases.actual: auth_required 2fa and status awaiting_auth for an enrolled user.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Confirm with the right PIN and a valid TOTP code
cases.expected: The workflow starts exactly once and the money moves
cases.actual: One workflow instance and the receiver is credited 60,000,000.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Confirm with the right PIN and no TOTP\n2. Confirm with the right PIN and a wrong TOTP
cases.expected: Neither starts the workflow; the wrong code counts toward the TOTP lockout
cases.actual: Missing TOTP ErrCredentialRequired, wrong TOTP ErrTOTPInvalid, no workflow started, then ErrTOTPLocked after five failures.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Request a 2fa-band transaction
cases.expected: 403 ERR_TOTP_NOT_ENROLLED and nothing is held
cases.actual: ErrTOTPNotEnrolled and no awaiting_auth row.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Confirm with the PIN and an extra totp field
cases.expected: The TOTP is ignored and the PIN decides
cases.actual: A PIN-band confirm with a wrong extra totp field still succeeds.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Confirm with a recovery code in place of the TOTP
cases.expected: Accepted once; the same recovery code on another transaction is refused
cases.actual: A recovery code accepted in place of the TOTP once; the same code refused on a second transaction.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.precondition: Superadmin and a user with TOTP
cases.steps: 1. Superadmin removes the TOTP with a reason
cases.expected: TOTP and recovery codes removed, audit totp.reset with admin id and reason, user notified
cases.actual: TOTP and recovery codes removed; one totp.reset audit row with the reason; no secret in the audit trail.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Each non-superadmin role calls the reset route
cases.expected: 403 ERR_FORBIDDEN_PERMISSION for viewer, kyc_reviewer, risk_officer and ops
cases.actual: 403 ERR_FORBIDDEN_PERMISSION for viewer, kyc_reviewer, risk_officer, ops; TOTP untouched.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Enrol and confirm through the three user routes, with and without auth and bad bodies
cases.expected: 200, 401 and 400 map to the documented error codes; GET never returns the secret
cases.actual: 401, 400, ERR_INVALID_CREDENTIALS, ERR_TOTP_INVALID; GET /v1/me/totp never shows the secret.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.precondition: A fake Twilio Verify server over TLS
cases.steps: 1. Send a code and a notice through the adapter
cases.expected: The right path, Basic auth and form fields are sent; the response is parsed; the code never appears in a log
cases.actual: POST to /2010-04-01/Accounts/{sid}/Messages.json with Basic auth (API key), To, From and Body; the log holds neither the code nor the API secret.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Build the sender for production with and without provider settings, and for dev and ci
cases.expected: Production without a provider refuses; production with Twilio settings uses Twilio; dev and ci use the log-only sender
cases.actual: Production without a provider refuses, incomplete Twilio settings refuse, complete settings use Twilio, dev and ci use the log-only sender.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Point the adapter at a loopback or private address
cases.expected: The call is refused by the outbound guard before any network input or output
cases.actual: A loopback destination is refused by the guard before any network round trip.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Load configuration in production without TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY, with a short key, and with a good key
cases.expected: Startup fails without a 32-byte key outside dev and ci; dev and ci get a fixed test key
cases.actual: Production and demo fail without a 32-byte base64 key, with a short or malformed key; dev and ci get a 32-byte test key.

cases.feature: TOTP second factor and code delivery (ADR-0017)
cases.steps: 1. Compare the permission tables
cases.expected: totp.reset is in both and the tables are equal; the new route is in the RBAC table
cases.actual: totp.reset is in the Go and admin-app tables and the new route is in the RBAC table.
cases.evidence: TestRolePermissionsMatchFrontend + TestEveryAdminRouteHasAPermission PASS (race, -p 1, 4-connection pool) - internal/auth/rbac_test.go; test/integration/admin/admin_rbac_test.go
